method.level1: GLO-90 tiles read at 300x300 (average, COG overviews); 0.25 deg blocks; coarse slope W1 vs target 400 m slope distribution (tolerance 2 deg); blocks with >60% slopes < 0.3 deg flagged
method.level2: GLO-30 22 km windows -> 200 m local UTM grids (same functions as mission_terrain) -> ATLAS-Pi tensor

clustering.note: Exploratory Ward clustering and median/MAD outlier scores; not a validated classification.

method.novelty: Great-circle distance to EGIZ catalog windows; <15 km existing, <40 km new characterisation, else new computational candidate. Published-literature novelty was not checked for every block.

screen_agreement.note: Level-1 coarse match uses one ~370 m slope distribution; Level 2 uses multi-scale slope, traversability, roughness and relief with bootstrap. Disagreement is expected and is why Level 1 is only a screen.

limitations: Regional pilot, not a global search.
Level 1 uses GLO-90 at ~370 m and is a screen only.
Land cover, water and built fractions were not acquired: site constraints are unknown, not passed.
Discovery categories are computational; no candidate is a confirmed analog.
